notes:
Inbound SMB lead. Self-serve trial turned into quick discovery. Primary use: support-agent + doc search for knowledge base (SaaS customer support). Team size ~80, high chat volume during business hours (~30 RPS peak for bot requests across product and docs).

Key pain: want better canned-reply quality than current open-source baseline but are cost-sensitive. Asked explicitly: "Can we run Llama variants for dev but Mistral/Qwen for production to save cost?" Also: how big is accuracy delta vs token cost for Llama-2-13B -> Mistral-7B-Instruct -> Qwen-7B? Looking for recommended sweet spot.

Technical constraints: public cloud only (AWS), want SSO (SAML) for console, audit logging mandatory, optional KMS for encryption-at-rest. Will not pursue private/on-prem now.

SE notes (Hannah): customer cares most about latency p95 < 350ms for short-chat flows and embeddings turnaround < 200ms for vector search. Bulk rerank jobs can be async and offload to cheaper batch runs. Request: provide a cost-per-conversation estimate for 5k monthly active users with average 80 tokens per conversation.

Commercial: SMB price sensitivity; likely to convert to paid hosted plan if unit economics are < $0.02 per conversation. Estimated ARR ask ~5k-25k. 

Quote from CTO on call: "We need 90% of the quality but at 50% of the cost of our existing provider to justify moving everything."

Proposed approach: run A/B between Mistral-7B-Instruct (cheaper) and a tuned Llama-2-13B-lite variant using Redwood Optimize suggestions; use prefix caching and batching to hit latency targets. Provide sample prompt engineering examples and cost projection spreadsheet.

Open items: confirm support for customer KMS key with hosted deployment, share per-token pricing tiers for mid-month scaling, provide sample eval prompt-set to measure quality delta between models.
